title: 调度 DAG：拓扑排序 / 关键路径 / 循环依赖检测 / 最大并行度
code:
# 调度 DAG：拓扑排序 / 关键路径（makespan）/ 循环依赖检测 / 最大并行度
from collections import defaultdict

DUR = {
    "ods_sync":   2,
    "dwd_order":  3,
    "dwd_user":   2,
    "dwd_item":   2,
    "dws_trade":  4,
    "dws_user":   2,
    "ads_gmv":    1,
    "ads_item":   1,
    "ads_kpi":    2,
    "ads_retain": 2,
}
EDGES = [
    ("ods_sync",  "dwd_order"),
    ("ods_sync",  "dwd_user"),
    ("ods_sync",  "dwd_item"),
    ("dwd_order", "dws_trade"),
    ("dwd_user",  "dws_trade"),
    ("dwd_user",  "dws_user"),
    ("dwd_item",  "ads_item"),
    ("dws_trade", "ads_gmv"),
    ("dws_trade", "ads_kpi"),
    ("dws_user",  "ads_kpi"),
    ("dws_user",  "ads_retain"),
]
# 用例 B：误加一条回边，制造循环依赖
EDGES_B = EDGES + [("ads_item", "ods_sync")]


def build_adj(edges):
    adj = defaultdict(list)
    for u, v in sorted(edges):
        adj[u].append(v)
    return adj


def topo_sort(nodes, edges):
    """Kahn 算法；ready 集按名字排序保证输出确定性。"""
    adj = build_adj(edges)
    indeg = {n: 0 for n in nodes}
    for u, v in sorted(edges):
        indeg[v] += 1
    ready = sorted(n for n in nodes if indeg[n] == 0)
    order = []
    while ready:
        n = ready.pop(0)
        order.append(n)
        for v in sorted(adj[n]):
            indeg[v] -= 1
            if indeg[v] == 0:
                ready.append(v)
        ready.sort()
    remain = [n for n in sorted(nodes) if n not in order]
    return order, remain


def schedule(nodes, dur, edges):
    """最早开始 / 最早完成时间；返回 (start, finish, order)。"""
    order, _ = topo_sort(nodes, edges)
    start = {n: 0 for n in nodes}
    finish = {}
    for n in order:
        finish[n] = start[n] + dur[n]
        for u, v in sorted(edges):
            if u == n:
                start[v] = max(start[v], finish[n])
    return start, finish, order


def latest_start_finish(nodes, dur, edges, order, makespan):
    succ = defaultdict(list)
    for u, v in sorted(edges):
        succ[u].append(v)
    lf = {n: makespan for n in nodes}
    for n in reversed(order):
        if succ[n]:
            lf[n] = min(lf[v] - dur[v] for v in succ[n])
    ls = {n: lf[n] - dur[n] for n in nodes}
    return lf, ls


def max_parallelism(nodes, start, finish):
    horizon = max(finish.values())
    best = 0
    for t in range(horizon):
        running = sum(1 for n in nodes if start[n] <= t < finish[n])
        best = max(best, running)
    return best


nodes = sorted(DUR.keys())

# ---- 用例 A：无环 DAG ----
order, remain = topo_sort(nodes, EDGES)
start, finish, order = schedule(nodes, DUR, EDGES)
makespan = max(finish.values())
lf, ls = latest_start_finish(nodes, DUR, EDGES, order, makespan)
critical = [n for n in order if ls[n] - start[n] == 0]
mp = max_parallelism(nodes, start, finish)

print("== 用例 A：合法的离线调度 DAG ==")
print("拓扑执行顺序（Kahn，同层按名字排序）:")
print("  " + " -> ".join(order))
print("")
print("任务时间窗（整数时钟单位）:")
for n in order:
    print("  " + n.ljust(11) + " 时长=" + str(DUR[n]).rjust(2) +
          " 窗口=[" + str(start[n]) + ", " + str(finish[n]) + ")  总浮动=" +
          str(ls[n] - start[n]) + ("  <- 关键路径" if (ls[n] - start[n]) == 0 else ""))
print("")
print("任务总数 = " + str(len(nodes)) + "，依赖边数 = " + str(len(EDGES)))
print("关键路径(makespan) = " + str(makespan))
print("关键路径上的任务链 = " + " -> ".join(critical))
print("关键路径耗时校验（链上时长之和 = makespan）: " +
      str(sum(DUR[n] for n in critical) == makespan))
print("最大并行度（同一时刻最多可并行执行的任务数） = " + str(mp))
cycle_a = bool(remain)
print("是否检测到循环依赖 = " + str(cycle_a))

# ---- 用例 B：含环 DAG ----
order_b, remain_b = topo_sort(nodes, EDGES_B)
print("")
print("== 用例 B：误加回边 ads_item -> ods_sync（期望检测到环） ==")
print("  拓扑排序只能排出 " + str(len(order_b)) + " / " + str(len(nodes)) + " 个任务")
print("  剩余无法排入的任务（环上节点） = " + str(sorted(remain_b)))
cycle_b = bool(remain_b)
print("  是否检测到循环依赖 = " + str(cycle_b))
print("")
print("判据 1（无环 DAG 拓扑排序覆盖全部任务）: " + str(not cycle_a and len(order) == len(nodes)))
print("判据 2（含环 DAG 检测出循环依赖）: " + str(cycle_b))
print("判据 3（关键路径 = " + str(makespan) + " 且最大并行度 = " + str(mp) + "）: " +
      str(makespan == 11 and mp == 3))
